cover.description: language-neutral like `download` / `trailer` (the creator writes it to every locale); not shown by the reader yet

download.description: the season's downloads (the music album), shown below its chapter list

supporters.description: who supported the season, in order: "Supported by" at the end of the reader's credits fine print

trailer.description: the toon page's desktop hero: a muted background loop + the button to the trailer chapter (language-neutral)

credits.deprecated: moved to `<toon>/_/credits.json` (the creator shows it read-only); the viewer never rendered it

lettering.description: the image is lettering-free: the UI renders the title over it (default false = shown as it is)

Cover.description: A toon's / season's cover (language-neutral, owner 2026-10-01: media are shared by all languages). The artwork carries no text: with `lettering: true` the UI sets the toon's name + the season's title over it in the reader's language (`CoverLettering` in `@scutoons/reader`, agents/DATA.md "Language-independent media"). Without it the image is shown as it is – for artwork that still has its title baked in (catpope until the lettering-free cover is delivered).

music.description: the music album (a zip), path in the toon's CDN folder; no path = no download

complete.description: everything of the season in one file, if there is one

image.description: decorative image beside the reader's music button (e.g. the record's cut-out), path in the toon's CDN folder

Download.description: A season's downloads (the reader's `/<toon>/download` page, linked below the season's chapter list)

logo.description: logo image path in the toon's CDN folder (like the season's other images)

Supporter.description: A supporter of a season (a logo row at the end of the credits fine print; without a logo its name as text)

loop.description: CDN path of the muted background loop (H.264 MP4, no audio track needed); the default after `sources`

sources.description: other encodings of the loop, tried first in this order (e.g. 1920 px for `(min-width: 1600px)`)

poster.description: CDN path of the poster image (shown before the loop plays and with reduced motion)

chapter.description: the chapter the trailer buttons open, default 0 (the prologue)

SeasonTrailer.description: The season's trailer on the toon page (owner 2026-10-01, desktop hero): a short muted montage looping behind the title, and "Trailer ansehen" / "Ton an" open the trailer chapter (the prologue) with sound. Language-neutral like `download`.

SliceVideoSource.description: One encoding of a slice video: a CDN path like `SliceVideo.src` + an optional media query (`<source media>`)

Credits.deprecated: moved to `<toon>/_/credits.json` (`ToonCredits`, credits.ts); the creator shows it read-only

status.description: Visibility of the chapter in this locale – the single source of truth (a toon may release de before en): `published` = listed and readable, `draft` = hidden (shown in dev only), `coming-soon` = listed, not readable.
